sovereign_country.strategic_role: 泛欧数字贸易门户、极速低成本在线设立与新锐EMI银行开户

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Marine Fuel Bunkering and Lubricant Replenishment

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone BIT/DTAA concluded by the Cayman Islands; UK investment treaty protections may extend by territorial extension declaration.
UK-Cayman Islands Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) in force.
Cayman Islands participates in the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework on Base Erosion and Profit Shifting and the OECD Common Reporting Standard.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Regulations (2023 Revision) issued under the Proceeds of Crime Act (2021 Revision); Companies Act (2021 Revision), Part X (Registration of Beneficial Ownership); Beneficial Ownership Transparency Act (2021 Revision) and the Limited Liability Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations; Monetary Authority Act (2021 Revision); CIMA Guidance Notes on the Prevention and Detection of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2021).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner's valid passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / notary public of the individual's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the country of issuance is a Hague Convention party; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential or business address (utility bill or bank statement)
Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency for corporate shareholders and corporate directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of corporations in the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / constitutional documents of corporate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction companies registry or legal counsel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's reference letter from principal banking counterparty
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization may be required for foreign bank references; otherwise notarization accepted

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Registered agents and the exempted company must apply risk-based customer due diligence under the CIMA Guidance Notes. All shareholders, directors, UBOs, counterparties and financing banks must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury sanctions list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list, and domestic Cayman Islands Criminal Justice (Money Laundering) and sanctions notices. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, high-risk jurisdictions and politically exposed corporate structures; negative news and open-source checks are required at on-boarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cayman Islands General Registry – Companies Section (CORIS online registry portal, www.ciregistry.gov.ky)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be distinguishable from existing reserved or registered names and must not be misleading. Non-English names require an English transcription or transliteration into Latin characters; the Registrar may require a certified English translation. Suffixes and abbreviations must be expressed exactly as permitted by law, and the name of an exempted company must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' unless otherwise sanctioned by law.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is not automatically renewable; an applying registered office provider must file a fresh reservation before the initial 90-day window expires, subject to the applicable re-filing fee. If the Registrar refuses a name, the provider may submit a written reconsideration request to the General Registry within 21 days of the refusal, supported by a legal memorandum and, for sensitive tokens, the requisite sectoral regulator approval. If the reconsideration is denied, an appeal may be brought to the Grand Court of the Cayman Islands within 21 days of the denial notification. An alternate non-conflicting name may be resubmitted immediately.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office cannot satisfy the statutory registered office requirement. The exempted company must maintain a registered office in the Cayman Islands at the premises of a licensed corporate services provider. A non-statutory virtual office may be used for correspondence, but any claim to non-resident operation without local substantive presence may trigger economic substance review under the International Tax Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act, particularly for headquarters, distribution and service centre, or shipping activities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: estimated 15% annual probability of unannounced registered-office inspection by CIMA or the Registrar in the scope of anti-money-laundering supervision; operational inspection probability is elevated (approximately 30%) for marine bunkering activities that call at UK or Cayman ports, where port authorities and UK Border Force may conduct random environmental, maritime and fuel-security inspections.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation registration fee for exempted company with authorized capital up to USD 50,000
Registered office and registered agent service fee (first year)
Drafting of memorandum and articles of association, corporate governance records and UBO register framework
AML/CFT and UBO KYC screening, PEP/sanctions vetting and beneficial ownership register preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark and statutory compliance requirement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille / consular legalization of KYC documents (bundle of five documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent legalization authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee plus notary service market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account opening facilitation and AML compliance review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: EMI / bank relationship manager and local counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, translation and administrative requisition fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2006 (UK), Part 34 (ss. 1046-1059) governing registration of overseas companies; Overseas Companies Regulations 2009 (SI 2009/2201); underlying corporate vehicle constituted under Cayman Islands Companies Act (2024 Revision), s. 21 (Exempted Company).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies House (UK Registrar of Companies), Cardiff, United Kingdom — Overseas Company Register.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form OSBR01 (Overseas Company: Registration of Particulars and UK Establishment), filed with certified constitutional documents of the Cayman Exempted Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued capital applies to the UK establishment; the Cayman Exempted Company may be incorporated with one share of US$1. No escrow account is mandated under UK law; operating funds are held in an ordinary corporate bank account pending licence activation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the company adopt and file all incorporation documents, subscribe for the share capital in accordance with the exempted company's memorandum, and designate the registered office at the registered agent's address. RESOLVED FURTHER that the following persons be appointed as first directors, the corporate secretary, and the UK resident representative for service of process, each authorized to execute all filings and banking mandates. RESOLVED that the directors open bank accounts, appoint the initial auditor if required, and approve the UK establishment registration with Companies House under the Overseas Companies Regulations. RESOLVED that the directors be authorized to obtain all bunkering and environmental licences and to execute commercial agreements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: UK Name Clearance and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Run a name availability screening for the UK establishment through the Companies House online tool; confirm the proposed name does not infringe the Civil Aviation Authority or sensitive-word restrictions under ss. 1193-1194 of the Companies Act 2006; document the search result for the file.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation of Cayman Exempted Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of Good Standing dated within 3 months
Name availability screening report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or sensitivity, re-file under a distinctive house name or obtain the written consent of the existing holder and submit Companies House Form NRAC for approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Apostille Legalization of Cayman Corporate Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: UK Notary Public; Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) Legalisation Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have the Cayman certificate of incorporation, memorandum, articles, and good standing certificate notarized; affix a Hague Apostille through the FCDO Legalisation Office; prepare sworn English translations if any instrument is issued in a language other than English.
required_dossiers: Notarized and apostilled Certificate of Incorporation
Apostilled Memorandum and Articles of Association
Cayman Tax Exemption Certificate under the Tax Concessions Act
Sworn English translation of any non-English document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the apostille is defective, reapply with corrected certified copies; if language issues arise, supply a fresh sworn translation and retain the original for inspection by Companies House.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Form OSBR01 with Companies House
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit Form OSBR01 with full particulars of the Cayman Exempted Company, the UK establishment address, directors and secretary details, and the UK resident person authorized to accept service of process; pay the statutory fee online; retain the Companies House acknowledgement letter.
required_dossiers: Completed Form OSBR01
Apostilled Certificate of Incorporation
Current list of directors and officers with service addresses
UK address for service of process
Financial statements of the Cayman parent (if branch exemption not available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, file a corrective submission within 14 days with reconciled particulars; if Companies House issues a strike-off notice, respond formally with an explanation and resubmit the OSBR01 with updated certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Designation of Registered Office and UK Establishment Address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure a physical UK registered office and establishment address through a registered office service provider or law firm; file Form OSAD03 if the adopted address differs from that stated on OSBR01; ensure statutory signage is displayed at the premises.
required_dossiers: Consent letter from registered office provider
Form OSAD03 (change of registered establishment address) where applicable
Lease or occupancy agreement evidencing physical premises
Fire and building safety compliance checklist for the premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the address is rejected as not being a physical location, engage an approved registered office provider and file Form OSAD03 within 14 days of the notice to protect the registration from de-listing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution, Officer Appointments and PSC Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural board meeting; adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution; record the appointment of first directors, corporate secretary, and UK process agent; file Form PSC01/PSC07 and the associated confirmation statement (CS01) to complete the UK public register; minute all resolutions in the statutory books.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution
Signed consents to act from first directors, secretary and UK process agent
Form PSC01 / PSC07 for people with significant control
Form CS01 confirmation statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer's identity verification fails, appoint an alternative director with a valid UK residential address and file corrective particulars at Companies House with verified nationality and residence data.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC); UK clearing banks and EMIs; FCA-regulated payment institutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the UK establishment with HMRC for Corporation Tax and, if applicable, PAYE/NI using Form CT41G or the online gateway; open a corporate bank account supporting SWIFT wire and standby letters of credit; provide the AML/KYC pack and the board resolution appointing signatories for payment rails.
required_dossiers: HMRC Form CT41G (corporation tax registration)
AML/KYC pack with beneficial ownership register
Board resolution authorizing bank signatories and SWIFT / Standby LC services
Proof of registered office and foreign company registration number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If HMRC queries the registration, submit a management control and permanent establishment analysis; if a bank declines the account on AML grounds, file an enhanced due diligence pack, obtain a professional introducer attestation, or apply to an EMI with higher-risk customer committee approval.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA); UK Health and Safety Executive (HSE); relevant Harbour Authority (e.g., Port of London Authority) acting as local licensing body under the Harbours Act 1964.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bunkering Operator Licence and Port Marine Safety Code Compliance Certificate, together with a Petroleum/OSDU Fuel Handling Permit issued under the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 and the Dangerous Substances and Explosive Atmospheres Regulations 2002.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Agency (England) and Marine Management Organisation (MMO) for marine licensing; Natural Resources Body for devolved coastal waters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Medium Tier — EIA Screening Opinion and Environmental Permit (mineral oil storage and waste handling) required; a Full EIA Report is triggered only when new bunkering infrastructure exceeds port development thresholds under the EIA Directive transposition.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: MARPOL Annex I (no oily water discharge exceeding 15 ppm) and Annex VI (ECA fuel sulphur content at or below 0.10% m/m; global cap 0.50% m/m); VOC and NOx controls per Merchant Shipping (Prevention of Air Pollution) Regulations; Pollution Prevention and Control (PPC) permit limits for wastewater and waste handling under the Environmental Permitting Regulations 2016.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire risk assessment and certification under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005; hazardous area zoning (ATEX) per DSEAR 2002 for fuel storage and transfer points; structural load and mooring inspections by the Harbour Authority; HSE workplace inspection clearance and Port Facility Security (ISPS) compliance certification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (UK's central bank); HM Treasury (exchange control policy and international financial sanctions); Financial Conduct Authority (regulatory oversight of payment and FX services)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The UK operates full convertibility for both current and capital account transactions without routine exchange controls. Non-resident companies may freely remit dividends, royalties, and other income subject to withholding taxes and banking transparency checks. No central bank approval is required for profit repatriation; however, banks impose enhanced due diligence on Cayman entities to combat money laundering and verify that funds are not derived from a sanctioned source.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirements or mandatory conversion ratios in the United Kingdom. Export receipts and bunkering revenues may be retained in any currency designated by the exporter. This applies equally to foreign-owned entities operating through UK-registered bank accounts; all flows are subject to record-keeping obligations under The Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2019.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low. Legal constraints: Most UK-authorised e-money institutions (EMIs) under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 restrict onboarding of legal entities incorporated in offshore financial centres such as the Cayman Islands unless the entity has substantive UK presence or the EMI has a dedicated cross-border corporate desk. UK EMIs that serve non-UK corporate clients generally require a UK registered address or a director with UK residency. In addition, the shipping/fuel sector is categorised as 'high value dealer' under Money Laundering Regulations, and EMIs without trade-finance due diligence capabilities decline such accounts. Offshore EMIs (e.g., based in Lithuania or Malta) are not recognised as UK payment institutions and can only provide services on a cross-border basis with an FCA passport; they face additional friction in settling to UK bank accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under Joint Money Laundering Steering Group (JMLSG) guidance, banks may conduct remote video interviews for corporate clients, but for Cayman Exempted Companies classified as enhanced risk, most Tier-1 UK banks mandate at least one face-to-face interview with the ultimate beneficial owner or a senior company officer, either at a UK branch or via an overseas branch, unless an exemption is granted for a regulated professional introducer. Alternatively, a certified copy of the KYC by a UK-regulated solicitor or accountant may be accepted by certain banks, but a physical presence requirement remains common.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore corporate in a jurisdiction with tax haven status (Cayman Islands)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Certificate of Compliance from Cayman General Registry; register of directors and members; proof of economic substance or exemption from Cayman economic substance requirements; UBO declaration (PSC) with identification documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk marine fuel bunkering industry vulnerable to sanctions evasion and smuggling
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid bunkering licence and ISCC/IMPA registration; charter party and shipping contracts; port authority approvals; vessel AIS data; transaction risk assessments; sanctions screening logs; identity and underlying documentation of counterparties; end-user declaration for marine fuel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large cross-border wire transfers and multi-currency flows requiring beneficial ownership transparency
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed board resolution approving account and signatories; source of funds report (3-6 months); audited financial statements; forecast of expected trade volumes; tax residency certificate; available substance documentation; payment flow diagram with contractual basis.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'EQUI' (equity injection) or 'PURIP' (property income) depending on nature. The remitting Cayman bank must include the documented source of funds (Cayman company resolution and bank references). Payments should be routed to the UK corporate operational account with a clear reference to the Charter or Ownership Agreement. Verification requires a Board Resolution authorising capital injection and a certificate from a licensed accountant confirming the funds are not from illicit proceeds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For bunker supplier settlement, use SWIFT MT103 for invoices below USD 250,000; for larger bulk fuel purchases, use Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) with standard ISBP 745 guidelines. Standby LCs (ICC URDG 758) are recommended as payment guarantees for port authorities and fuel suppliers. All messages must include UN/EDIFACT invoice references and the contract's Incoterms (usually IFO/ISO 8217 specification and quantity). The UK clearing system (CHAPS) settles same-day GBP, while TARGET2 and the US Fedwire are used for EUR/USD via the bank's correspondent network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (vanilla, up to 24 months)
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry, Registrar of Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of CI$100 per month for each month the return is overdue; continuing default may result in Registrar-initiated strike-off under s. 106 of the Companies Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee under the Companies Act fee schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry, Revenue and Fees Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month, capped at 50%; failure to pay for a continuous period permits the Registrar to strike off the company and dissolve it under the Companies Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification under the International Tax Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry, Tax Information Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial penalty of CI$500; recurring or continuing default attracts CI$1,000 and up to CI$10,000, with possible court-ordered imprisonment of responsible officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation and Change Filing under the Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry via Beneficial Ownership Secure System (BOSS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation performed in conjunction with the annual compliance review; any share-transfer or UBO change filed within 15 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of CI$250 per default, plus CI$25 per day for continuing non-compliance; deliberate false confirmation or failure to disclose a UBO is a criminal offence on the part of directors and officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Trade and Business Licence Renewal for marine bunkering and refueling operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce and Investment, Cayman Islands Government
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal window from 1 October through 31 December of each licence year; the licence expires on 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of 10% of the licence fee for the first month and a cumulative penalty thereafter; unlicensed bunkering activity may result in fines up to CI$10,000, suspension of the licence, and liability for unpaid duties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Cayman exempted companies are not subject to a general statutory audit mandate solely by reason of turnover or assets. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only where the company holds a CIMA licence (e.g., bank, trust, insurance, fund administrator), where shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights serve a valid audit request, or where the Department of Commerce and Investment requires an audit in respect of a Trade and Business Licence for marine fuel supply. For ship bunkering entities, lenders and charter counterparties commonly impose an IFRS audit as a contractual necessity if annual turnover exceeds CI$5 million.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Cayman has no domestic statutory GAAP; financial records are expected to be kept in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, with IFRS being the universal benchmark for externally reported and audited financial statements. CIMA-regulated funds and certain licensed entities may alternatively use US GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered office must maintain the Beneficial Ownership Register and carry out at least one annual compliance review to reconfirm all beneficial owners. Any share transfer or any other change to beneficial ownership must be reported to the registered agent and filed with the Beneficial Ownership Secure System within 15 days of the change. If no change has occurred, a nil-confirmation must be recorded in the annual compliance certificate and signed by authorised officers of the exempted company.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Mortgages and Charges (if any)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (Corporation Tax main rate for profits exceeding £250,000; FY2024/FY2025)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 19% small profits rate on profits ≤ £50,000; marginal relief fraction 3/200 for profits £50,001–£250,000 producing a 26.5% marginal rate in the taper band; 100% Full Expensing for qualifying plant and machinery (available until 2026); R&D tax credit enhancements; Tonnage Tax unavailable for pure bunkering (non-qualifying incidental activity). A Cayman Exempted Company is chargeable only on UK PE profits under CTA 2009 s.5 / CTA 2010 s.1105.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form CT600 (Company Tax Return) — filed electronically via HMRC Online Services / Corporation Tax filing portal (Government Gateway); mandatory if the Cayman Exempted Company has a UK permanent establishment (PE) carrying on a trade
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing: within 12 months of the end of the accounting period (payment due 9 months + 1 day after period-end for profits ≤ £1.5m; quarterly installments for large companies)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique Taxpayer Reference of the UK PE
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Register the UK PE with HMRC before the filing deadline and quote the 10-digit UTR
Align with statutory accounts; an AP cannot exceed 12 months

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: UK GAAP / IFRS profit attributable to the UK PE after apportionment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply OECD PE profit attribution (AOA); only UK PE books are taxable, not global offshore results

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Losses brought forward and deductible expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses of the same UK trade may be set off; carry-forward is unlimited in time but restricted to 50% of profits above £5m allowance

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable income after reliefs, allowable expenses, and capital allowances
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back non-allowable expenses of the UK PE; deduct capital allowances on PE plant and machinery
Apply 19%/25%/marginal relief based on augmented profits of the UK PE

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax deducted at source on UK dividends/interest
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents can claim repayment against CT liability where beneficial owner
Pay by Corporation Tax payment reference by the 9-month-and-1-day deadline

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: £100 (≤3 months), £200 (3–6 months), £500 (6–12 months), £1,000 (>12 months), plus £10/day daily penalty for up to 90 days from 3 months late; penalties double for a second consecutive late return. Late payment: interest at Bank of England base rate + 2.5% (currently 7.75% p.a.) plus a 2.5% surcharge at 30 days/6 months/12 months of unpaid tax
